headline: Transfer rumors, news: Liverpool in talks to sign Ismaïla Sarr
description: Crystal Palace winger Ismaïla Sarr is pushing for a move to Liverpool before the summer transfer window closes. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Tottenham boss Roberto De Zerbi defends 'crucial' Sandro Tonali after tough loss to Newcastle
description: Roberto De Zerbi leapt to the defence of Tottenham midfielder Sandro Tonali after he endured a night to forget in a 2-0 loss at home to his old club Newcastle.

headline: Muñoz, Liverpool rescue late 2-2 draw against Forest
description: Víctor Muñoz's powerful 82nd-minute strike levels late for Liverpool in their home opener against Nottingham Forest.

headline: Newcastle hand big-spending Spurs second-consecutive EPL loss
description: Anthony Elanga and Yoane Wisse score for the Magpies to leave a deflated Tottenham pointless after two Premier League games.
